issue.title: test_guard_wiring_fails_a_leaking_test_but_not_a_monkeypatched_one fails under a heavily loaded just check, passes in isolation
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-14n.12 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1), filed by the sase-14n land agent. On 2026-09-20 the recorded check run 45eb5cda0623db2456752cfd945d1ca1 (just check under heavy host load, load average 44+; 44232 passed) failed this node together with three other unrelated nodes. The phase agent reran it in isolation on the same tree and it passed. The phase diff (gate-shell continuation mode in src/sase/notification_gates/model_request.py and validation.py) does not touch this code. Observed fail rate: 1 failure under the loaded full lane, 0 in isolation.
